title: C/Zephyr: ASSIGNED_SF (0x14) DIO option parser absent; modem config hardcodes SF9 placeholder
description:
Req R-02-008 (spec/02-physical-link.md 3.4, MUST): 'Nodes MUST use assigned SF for all TX after joining' via ASSIGNED_SF RPL DIO option, project-local Type 0x14.

Classification: implemented+tested in Rust; not-implemented in C.
Evidence: Rust rust/lichen-core/src/constants.rs:63-66 (DIO_OPTION_ASSIGNED_SF=0x14), rust/lichen-core/src/sf_assignment.rs:62-76 (effective_sf), :140-175 (make/parse option), test rust/lichen-core/tests/sf_assignment_vectors.rs:42-86 consuming test/vectors/sf_assignment.json.
C gap: CONFIG_LICHEN_SF_ASSIGNMENT_ENABLED exists (lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/Kconfig:190-196) but default n, no 0x14 parser anywhere in lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl, and the modem config hardcodes a placeholder 'SF_9 if CONFIG_LICHEN_SF_ASSIGNMENT_ENABLED else SF_10' (lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2.c:273) instead of applying an assigned SF.

Suggested placement: implement 0x14 DIO option parse/store in lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl + apply effective SF in lichen/subsys/lichen/l2 radio config; mirror rust/lichen-core/src/sf_assignment.rs. Add C consumer for sf_assignment.json.
